dogecoin.text:
Elon Musk reveals a preference for Dogecoin as coin scouts for CEO 😃

#Musk responded to an April Fools’ #Dogecoin poll in which he is named among potential CEO candidates alongside heavy blockchain hitters #VitalikButerin, Charlie Lee, and Marshall Hayner. Musk tweeted: https://t.co/GtnIGIi6p6
